_comment: Pool 3 — recently funded early-stage startups, sourced 2026-08-13 from Entrackr and Inc42 weekly funding reports plus press verification. Deliberately NOT from the Apify LinkedIn harvest, which returned 0 usable leads from 180 posts (see _apify_result below).
_apify_result: Ran harvestapi/linkedin-post-search on 14 founder-intent queries, 180 posts, cost ~$0.42, kept 0. Rejection breakdown: 67 no ops keyword or early-stage tell, 43 too long (all thought-leadership on inspection), 42 promo, 12 content-not-ask, 10 vendor author. LinkedIn post search is dominated by engagement-optimised content; clienthunt measured ~1% genuine-ask rate, so 180 posts should have yielded 1-2 and yielded none. Not a tuning problem. Do not re-run this mechanism without changing the source. $2.30 of the $5 free tier remains.
_why_this_pool: Early stage is the user's own thesis and it is correct: a company that just raised has budget, is hiring, and has NO incumbent stack to rip out, so switching cost is zero. A 200-person company has Darwinbox and HubSpot already. A 6-person one has a WhatsApp group and a spreadsheet.
_selection: Dropped River Mobility ($120M Series C), Sarvam ($74M Series B), BlissClub (Series B) and Leap India (pre-IPO) as far too large for a $14.99/seat motion. Kept seed and small Series A where the customer base is consumer or trade facing, because that is where WhatsApp and Instagram are the real channels.
